mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary policy cycle, lowering discount rates and increasing equity present value, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05) during periods of FEDFUNDS decline.

mechanism_narrative: A sudden increase in monthly payroll employment (PAYEMS) above 150,000 persons triggers a positive S&P 500 forward return over the next 5 trading days as market interprets strong labor demand as a growth signal.
failure_condition: 20-day returns remain negative despite PAYEMS crossing the threshold, or the effect diminishes below 0.5% in subsequent months.

mechanism_narrative: When quarterly demand (GDPC1) exceeds monthly supply (INDPRO) by 5% or more, it creates upward pressure on equity valuations, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: No significant positive returns (t-test p > 0.05) when GDPC1 > INDPRO by 5% over 3-month rolling average.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly CPIAUCSL inflation rate exceeding 1% triggers a positive S&P 500 forward return over the next 20 trading days as investors anticipate sustained inflation and adjust portfolios accordingly.
failure_condition: 20-day returns not significantly positive (p > 0.05) when CPIAUCSL inflation crosses 1% threshold.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the federal funds rate signals tightening monetary policy, raising discount rates and compressing equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day returns not significantly negative (p > 0.05) during periods of FEDFUNDS increases.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in monthly unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 4.5% triggers positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as market interprets labor market strengthening as a growth catalyst.
failure_condition: 20-day returns not significantly positive (p > 0.05) despite UNRATE crossing below 4.5%.

mechanism_narrative: When monthly housing demand (HOUST) and retail sales demand (RSAFS) both increase by >5% month-over-month, it amplifies equity demand, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST > HOUST_prev * 1.05 AND RSAFS > RSAFS_prev * 1.05 over 2-month rolling average
failure_condition: No significant positive returns (t-test p > 0.05) when both proxies exceed 5% growth over 2-month average.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion regime, a sustained decline in the federal funds rate below 2% generates positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as markets anticipate prolonged growth.
failure_condition: 20-day returns not significantly positive (p > 0.05) during late-cycle expansion periods despite FEDFUNDS below 2%.
